america-one-room.name: America in One Room deliberative poll
america-one-room.outcome: 523 random voters; parties moved closer on 22 of 26 polarizing proposals; outparty warmth up 13-14 points
america-one-room.limits: One weekend; funder also operated it; much sourcing from organizers' own reports.
america-one-room.locator: "Of 26 proposals that were most polarizing" section on results; 523 delegates, control group 844

braver-angels-campus-study.name: Independent study of Braver Angels Red/Blue workshops
braver-angels-campus-study.outcome: 22% less direct hostility toward the other party one week later; some effects lasted six months
braver-angels-campus-study.limits: College students on four campuses; some effects faded by six months; pandemic cut follow-up meetings.
braver-angels-campus-study.locator: "22% less direct hostility toward people in the other party"

braver-angels-thermometer.name: Braver Angels internal workshop evaluation
braver-angels-thermometer.outcome: Red/Blue workshop: outgroup feeling thermometer (0-to-100 scale) 36 before, 54 after; ingroup 74 to 75
braver-angels-thermometer.limits: Run by the organization's own evaluation team; small sample; self-reported.
braver-angels-thermometer.locator: "“0” indicates the most unfavorable view of a group and “100” is the most favorable"

braver-angels-org.name: Braver Angels (founding, debates, critiques)
braver-angels-org.outcome: Founded after the 2016 election; pilot was a December 2016 weekend workshop in Ohio for 10 Clinton and 10 Trump supporters; nearly 275 structured debates in all 50 states by April 2022; ACTA has sponsored about 200 Braver Angels debates on more than 75 college campuses; interest groups include a film club, book club and faith caucus
braver-angels-org.limits: Participants mostly white, older, college-educated; Democrats outnumbered Republicans in 2021; critics such as Alex Zamalin (author of Against Civility) say the group deals only with civic politeness and does not address power dynamics.
braver-angels-org.locator: "weekend workshop in Ohio for 10 Clinton and 10 Trump supporters"; "about 200 Braver Angels debates on more than 75 college campuses"

thanksgiving-chen-rohla.name: Chen and Rohla Thanksgiving phone-location study
thanksgiving-chen-rohla.outcome: Mixed-politics families spent roughly 20-50 fewer minutes together; drop about 3x larger where political ads saturated TV
thanksgiving-chen-rohla.limits: Compares 2016 to 2015 only; a later replication found a smaller effect.
thanksgiving-chen-rohla.locator: "fuel on the fire" (Chen on political ads)

thanksgiving-replication.name: Frimer and Skitka replication (PLoS One)
thanksgiving-replication.outcome: Politically diverse dinners about 24 minutes (6%) shorter after covariates; the original study included Thanksgiving 2016, a presidential election year
thanksgiving-replication.limits: Individual studies mostly null; mega-analysis effect small.
thanksgiving-replication.locator: "politically diverse dinners were 24 minutes shorter than politically uniform ones"; "included a Thanksgiving dinner during a presidential election year (2016)"

perception-gap.name: More in Common Perception Gap study and quiz
perception-gap.outcome: Partisans think almost twice as many opponents hold extreme views as do; heavy news readers most distorted
perception-gap.limits: One survey of 2,100 Americans with YouGov, 2019; issues measured are a fixed set.
perception-gap.locator: "Americans have a deeply distorted understanding of each other."

deep-canvassing.name: Deep canvassing study (Broockman and Kalla, Science)
deep-canvassing.outcome: 10-15 minute listening conversations shifted attitudes on a charged social issue for at least three months
deep-canvassing.limits: One issue, one city; about one in 10 voters changed; measured for three months.
deep-canvassing.locator: "Canvassers do not need to be members of an affected group"

boston-talks.name: Boston secret abortion talks
boston-talks.outcome: After the 1994 Brookline, Massachusetts, abortion clinic murders, six leaders from opposite sides met in secret for six years; none changed position; they became friends. Facilitated by Essential Partners, then the Public Conversation Project
boston-talks.limits: Six people with skilled facilitators; first two years spent building trust; start year inferred from the Dec. 1994 shootings.
boston-talks.locator: "the 1994 Brookline, Massachusetts, abortion clinic murders"; "we were never going to agree"

essential-partners.name: Essential Partners dialogue guides and teacher trainings
essential-partners.outcome: Free field guide (Fostering Dialogue Across Divides); One-Day Professional Development for middle and high schools; practice includes building shared agreements
essential-partners.limits: Own site; reported 95% respected figure has no method on the page.
essential-partners.locator: Menus: "Our Free Guide", "One-Day Professional Development", "Building Agreements"

looping.name: Looping listening exercise (from Amanda Ripley's High Conflict)
looping.outcome: Two-minute speak, repeat back, check, correct, switch exercise
looping.limits: Classroom exercise page; no outcome data.
looping.locator: "listening to understand, not just to respond"

one-small-step.name: StoryCorps One Small Step
one-small-step.outcome: Matches people with different political views for a recorded 50-minute conversation
one-small-step.limits: No participant numbers or outcome data on the page; sign-up asks for ZIP code and political leaning.
one-small-step.locator: "brings people with different views together to record a 50–minute conversation"

living-room-conversations.name: Living Room Conversations
living-room-conversations.outcome: Free structured guides for small conversations in person or online since 2010
living-room-conversations.limits: Homepage had placeholder text when opened; no outcome data; group size not stated.
living-room-conversations.locator: "Since 2010, we have been equipping individuals, communities, and organizations"

ireland-assembly.name: Irish Citizens' Assembly
ireland-assembly.outcome: 99 randomly selected citizens, 12 weekends to April 2018, five topics, 77 recommendations; abortion recommendation led to 2018 referendum
ireland-assembly.limits: Heavy unpaid workload took a toll; some members withdrew; other reports awaited government action.
ireland-assembly.locator: "Members randomly selected from the voting population"

oregon-cir.name: Oregon Citizens' Initiative Review
oregon-cir.outcome: About two dozen random voters question both sides of a ballot measure and write a one-page voters' pamphlet statement
oregon-cir.limits: Not permanently funded; runs only in funded years, often for one measure.
oregon-cir.locator: "The state of Oregon created the first permanent Citizens' Initiative Review in 2010"

vtaiwan-uber.name: vTaiwan Pol.is process on Uber
vtaiwan-uber.outcome: About 3,000 people found points of agreement; government agreed to ratify them in May 2016
vtaiwan-uber.limits: Officials translated consensus into rules; tensions and fines on Uber drivers continued.
vtaiwan-uber.locator: "expressed a willingness to work with the UberTAXI platform under mutually-agreeable terms."

polis-tool.name: Pol.is open-source deliberation tool
polis-tool.place: Taiwan; Bowling Green area, KY; others
polis-tool.outcome: AGPL open source; no replies, only statements and votes; Kentucky plan: 2,370 of 3,940 ideas backed by over 80%
polis-tool.limits: Little independent evaluation; still needs human moderation and analysis.
polis-tool.locator: "Its algorithms are designed not for engagement and scrolling"

front-porch-forum.name: Front Porch Forum
front-porch-forum.outcome: Over 250 town forums, nearly 250,000 members; human-moderated email digests; no anonymity and no commenting on posts; 80% say people treat each other with respect (2023 survey by the Center for Media Engagement at the University of Texas-Austin)
front-porch-forum.limits: Mostly Vermont; survey is of its own users.
front-porch-forum.locator: "conducted by the Center for Media Engagement at the University of Texas-Austin"; "no commenting on posts"

disagree-better.name: National Governors Association Disagree Better initiative
disagree-better.outcome: 2023-2024 NGA Chair's Initiative of Utah Governor Spencer Cox, a Republican; suggests recording an ad with a governor or legislator from the other party; Cox and Colorado Governor Jared Polis, a Democrat, explain the approach in a video; tactics include public service announcements
disagree-better.limits: No outcome data on the page.
disagree-better.locator: "NGA Chair Utah Gov. Cox, a Republican"; "a legislator from the opposing party"

strengthening-democracy.name: Strengthening Democracy Challenge megastudy
strengthening-democracy.outcome: 252 submissions, 25 tested on 32,000 Americans for partisan animosity and anti-democratic attitudes
strengthening-democracy.limits: Opened page does not report which interventions worked or durability; search summaries say most reduced animosity.
strengthening-democracy.locator: "crowdsourced interventions from teams of academics, practitioners, and industry experts"

reuseNote: All exemplars gathered fresh in this run; web search budget ran out after 12 searches, so later sources were opened by direct URL. Repair run copied from 20261019-140045.
